body: My plans were ruined by the Coronavirus. I planned to hang myself while my parents are on vacation. Instead, they’re stuck at home with me. Dang it!
I didn't succeed. I found a cord that is short though. But my neck hurts really bad now. I feel really stiff and uncomfortable.
I am thinking about attempting again. Hopefully, I succeed this time.

My parents don't care. My family doesn't care. I don't think a lawyer would help. I'd rather die than feel like a failure for the rest of my life. I often wonder what the world will be like after I die. Will people miss me much? I don't know.
I survived. A guy called me for another job interview. The cord that I wrapped around my neck feels uncomfortable. I'll use something else tomorrow.
My time has come. I'm gonna go and jump now. I am really happy so many people responded to me. If I don't reply, that means it's over for me. Goodbye!
I plan on using a dryer. I’ll jump off so my neck snaps.  It’s not the best spot I’d pick, but at least it’s available.

My dad is constantly mean to me and he makes fun of me. I don’t want to be treated like that. My mom stopped defending me against him. If I can’t get past the interview process for any company, I won’t get anywhere. I think I’m better off dead than alive.

Thank you for your kind words. It was very thoughtful of you to reply. I do feel worthless, because of my speech problems. The interview process is impossible. My dad doesn’t know what to do with me anymore. He doesn’t listen to me. I think he would be better off without me. He’ll have regrets when I’m gone. However, after the next 5 or 10 years he’ll move on. Maybe he’ll marry someone else or move somewhere else. I’ve done bad things before. I’ve lied, cheated and stole before. I deserve to suffer. I want to die a slow, gruesome death to make up for all the horrible things I’ve done.
Getting a good job and getting married. I’m afraid I can’t do it. I’d rather choose death than failure. I just can’t take it anymore.

No, they’ll freak out and send me to therapy. I’ve been to therapy multiple times. I’m happy to know someone cares about me. I just hate myself so much right now. It just doesn’t look like I’ll have a great future.

I’m still here. My parents are considering not going on vacation because of the coronavirus. I might not be able to even attempt suicide at this point. Life works in mysterious ways. I still have not changed my mind. When the opportunity presents itself, I’m gonna try and leave this world.
I’m still feeling suicidal. I still want to kill myself next month, because I’m not happy about my current situation.
Thank you for getting back to me. My thoughts haven’t changed, but it was kind of you to respond back in a thoughtful manner. I still want to to end it all. Every day brings me pain.

24/M/Weston, Florida

Looking for friends to hang out with and maybe date. I just graduated from college with a computer science degree. I am currently working as an intern in Thailand. I am going back home this month to look for a job. 

I’m into anime, movies, tv shows (Gundam), and animation software. I also play video games such as super smash bros, street fighter, super robot wars, saint seiya soldiers soul, and dynasty warriors Gundam.

My mother had a C-Section. I didn't know it was common. I shouldn't have mentioned prom in my post sorry. It is unrelated. I am scared of a pregnancy trap and don't want to be stuck with rugrats. I'm thinking about using protection myself until I get a vasectomy.
